title: Outgoing webhook delivery with retries and signatures
tasks: webhook delivery with retries and signatures

requirements.text: Each delivery is signed with an HMAC over a timestamp and the exact body using the endpoint's secret
Failed deliveries (network errors, timeouts, non-2xx) are retried with exponential backoff, then marked dead after a maximum and can be replayed manually
Pending deliveries are persisted in the same transaction as the triggering change and survive process restarts
Each attempt has a timeout so a slow endpoint cannot hold a worker
Every delivery carries a unique event id that stays the same across retries so receivers can deduplicate
Endpoint URLs must be HTTPS and resolve to public addresses; redirects to internal hosts are not followed
Only authorized tenant members can register endpoints and view or rotate their secrets

evidence.name: webhook-signature: Stripe-style header vector and verification failures
outbox commits state and messages atomically and relays at least once

implementations.notes: In-memory outbox: retry with backoff, dead state and revive are tested; it is not durable across restarts

evidence.name: attemptTimeoutMs times out a hung attempt and retries it

implementations.notes: pg-boss queue with retries and a dead-letter queue; enqueuing in the same transaction as the change is the application's work

notes: capability:ip-cidr classifies public addresses and could back an SSRF guard, but no Genlib code resolves and pins endpoint addresses.
